EXISTING BRAIN-OWNED STRUCTURAL GENERATORS AND MECHANICAL SUBSTRATES HANDLE STATE DELEGATION VERIFICATION TOOL DISCOVERY EXACT COMPUTATION AND MECHANICAL I/O.
